reader.notes: LookupQualified resolves CONTROL operands over ordinary storage only (report section names never enter ByName), and IsReportSectionOnlyName fires only for a name declared in the Report Section AND NOWHERE ELSE, by design (its comment: a name also declared in ordinary storage resolves there). So an unqualified CONTROL operand that a referenceable sum counter also spells is silently bound to the Working-Storage item, while the same spelling in the Procedure Division is refused as ambiguous (COBOL2145). Every other refusal and the qualified forms conform.
